name: Giriş — boş form tarayıcı doğrulamasıyla engellenir

planSteps.description: Leave both email and password inputs empty and click the 'Giriş Yap' button
The browser's native required-field validation blocks submission: the email input is reported invalid (validity.valueMissing is true) and focus moves to it
The inline error element with id 'auth-error' remains empty (no 'E-posta veya şifre hatalı.' text)
The button text is still 'Giriş Yap' (it never changed to 'Lütfen bekle...')
